_about: SpaceX 是否在 2025-12-31 前执行星舰第 11 次飞行（Flight 11）的冻结证据包。信息截至 2025-09-30T23:59Z（发射之前）。

evidence.title: SpaceX targeting Oct. 13 for next Starship megarocket launch
evidence.excerpt: SpaceX announced on Monday (Sept. 29) that it's targeting Oct. 13 for Starship Flight 11.
evidence.claim: SpaceX 已公布目标日期，但截至信息日尚未发射，存在延期风险。

evidence.title: SpaceX schedules Starship Flight 11 test for October 13
evidence.excerpt: Next up: Flight 11 of Starship is targeted to launch as early as Monday, October 13
evidence.claim: 多家媒体确认目标窗口为 10 月中，属于计划而非既成事实。
